cast.title: Rolling Thunder
cast.overview: A recently-returned Vietnam POW loses his family and his right hand during a violent home invasion, and seeks retribution against those responsible.

cast.title: The Drowning Pool
cast.overview: Harper is brought to Louisiana to investigate an attempted blackmail scheme. He soon finds out that it involves an old flame of his and her daughter. He eventually finds himself caught in a power struggle between the matriarch of the family and a greedy oil baron, who wants their property. Poor Harper! Things are not as straight-forward as they initially appeared.

cast.title: The Nickel Ride
cast.overview: A world-weary crime boss is losing his grip on his organization.

cast.title: Latitude Zero
cast.overview: A massive underwater volcano erupts and puts a group of investigative scientists in danger. They are rescued by an atomic super submarine named The Alpha under the command of Captain McKenzie. The group is quickly taken to a vast underwater city known as Latitude Zero, a fantastic, Atlantean type utopia, a world beneath the ocean with its own sun. It is soon discovered that Captain McKenzie is at war with the evil Dr. Malic, a cruel scientist who wishes to rule mankind all the while conducting genetic experiments on humans and animals. Malic sends his agents to kidnap Dr. Okada, a human scientist who has created a serum that can immunize exposure to radiation.

cast.title: Human Experiments
cast.overview: A demented prison doctor performs gruesome shock therapy experiments on inmates.

cast.title: Judgment: The Court Martial of Lt. William Calley
cast.original_title: Judgment: The Court Martial of Lt. William Calley
cast.overview: This docudrama follows the court-martial of the title character, the man held responsible for the My Lai massacre during the Vietnam War.

cast.title: Coffy
cast.overview: After her younger sister gets involved in drugs and is severely injured by contaminated heroin, a nurse sets out on a mission of vengeance and vigilante justice, killing drug dealers, pimps, and mobsters who cross her path.

cast.title: Brubaker
cast.overview: The new warden of a small prison farm in Arkansas tries to clean it up of corruption after initially posing as an inmate.
